tools.name: scrape
tools.description: Page to clean markdown, routed to a healthy provider with automatic failover. Paid: $0.008 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only on success). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: scrape_lite
tools.description: URL to markdown: any public page as clean markdown, with failover (/v1/scrape/lite: $0.003 per page). Paid: $0.003 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only on success). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: map
tools.description: Same-site URLs found on the page plus sitemap URLs (robots.txt Sitemap lines or /sitemap.xml), deduped, up to limit (default 200, max 1000). Paid: map $0.001 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only on success). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: metadata
tools.description: Title, meta description, canonical, lang, OpenGraph and Twitter tags, and parsed JSON-LD blocks of an HTML page. Paid: metadata $0.001 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only on success). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: The visible part of a public page (1280x800 viewport, JavaScript rendered) as a base64 PNG in image_base64. Paid: $0.008 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only on success). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: screenshot_full
tools.description: The whole scrollable page (JavaScript rendered) as a base64 PNG in image_base64. Paid: $0.012 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only on success). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: search
tools.description: A query in, up to 10 ranked web results (title, url, snippet) out. Paid: $0.008 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only on success). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: pdf
tools.description: A public PDF URL in, its text page by page out (up to 50 pages, 10 MB; text-based PDFs). Paid: $0.008 USDC on Base via x402 (charged only when text comes back). Unpaid calls return x402 payment requirements; retry with _meta["x402/payment"].

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Free. Our price for a tier, how many providers are healthy right now, estimated latency, and payment status.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scrape_lite" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
